newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S AFRIBRAND SOARS ON JSE DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S AFRIBRAND SOARS ON JSE DEBUT.

text.p: South Africa's Afribrand Holdings Ltd made a strong debut on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, dealers said on Tuesday.

The share was the most active on the bourse, trading at 208 cents from its 100 cents issue price, after touching a high of 210 cents and a low of 196 cents. Volumes traded were 7.5 million shares valued at about 15 million rand.
"It is outstanding. It is above general market expectations and the volume is exceptionally large," one dealer said.

Afribrand said at the weekend that the premium on the one rand issue price could be between 150 and 200 cents. It specialises in marketing and distributing branded products into lower economic markets and particularly hawker shop sectors.
The company said that its private placing of shares was 75 times oversubscribed, one of the highest over-subscriptions for a share offer in South African investment history.
Local and foreign investors tried to pour 750 million rand into the company's 10 million rand public share offer in efforts to obtain a holding in the company.
Dealers said the share would trade in a band of 190 and 210 cents during the day, coming off slightly in the afternoon as the excitement diminished.
